record.material_as_written: Li6PS5Cl (LPSC(100) surface after reaction in pure CO2, surface region)
record.measurement_method: MLFF-based MD (Einstein relation from Li+ MSD), extrapolated to room temperature from 500-900 K
record.evidence_quote: the extrapolated room-temperature ion conductivities of the surface and bulk regions are 1.27 × 10−3 S/m and 2.15 × 10−4 S/m, respectively.
record.notes: Value is for the surface region (three Li layers near the top and bottom) of an LPSC(100) slab after CO2 reaction, from MD extrapolation; not an experimental total conductivity. The paper states 300 K explicitly; measurement_temperature_C left null since the paper does not give a Celsius value.
